checks: Triangulate using old vertices. In each intersected simplex the positive deficits of off-face vertices force all d-f such barycentric coordinates to be O(t), giving O(t^(d-f)). A simplex with no face vertex has a fixed positive deficit and contributes nothing for small t.

The cut plane attains its reference support threshold on a segment to an interior point. For small t all new vertices come from cut edges joining an on-face vertex to an old vertex of strictly positive deficit.
For nearby m the old off-face vertices have a uniform strict support gap. Every cut-edge vector a belongs to a finite list with n·a=-1, yielding h_K(m)-h_K(t)(m) at least t(1-C|m-n|), uniformly.

Pullback under the matched smooth affine chart changes the covector by O(|p|). Determinants are locally bounded, and a finite union of deleted pieces bounds both total loss and every cap loss independently of its normal.
